# ng-table

> Nx workspace for @ngp/table — a signal-based Angular table engine (libs/shared/table) and its docs site (apps/ng-table). Each project owns its own CONTEXT.md glossary and docs/adr/.

Generated by `tools/generate-llms-txt.mts` (`npm run llms`) — do not edit by hand; `npm run llms:check` fails on drift.

Multi-context repo: each app/lib below owns its own `CONTEXT.md` (glossary) and `docs/adr/`
(architectural decisions). There is no repo-root `CONTEXT.md`.

Dependencies between contexts: ng-table → Table.

## Contexts

- [ng-table](apps/ng-table/CONTEXT.md): Dark-only documentation and marketing site for NGP Table (`@ngp/table`); does not implement the table itself. ADRs: `apps/ng-table/docs/adr/`.
- [Table](libs/shared/table/CONTEXT.md): Standalone `@ngp/table` headless table primitive, extracted from Design System (ADR-0009). ADRs: `libs/shared/table/docs/adr/`.
